description: A comprehensive, production-ready dialog library for .NET MAUI applications featuring 12 dialog types (Alert, Confirm, Prompt, Editor, Loading, ActionList, ColorPicker, DatePicker, TimePicker, DateTimePicker, Toast, Snackbar), built-in theming with Material/Fluent/Cupertino presets, internationalization (English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese, Italian), MVVM support, input validation, custom animations, accessibility features, and telemetry. Supports iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS.
releaseNotes:
Version 1.5.0 - Major Feature Release:

NEW FEATURES:
• Date/Time Picker Dialogs: Three new picker dialogs
  - DatePickerDialog: Native date selection with min/max date constraints
  - TimePickerDialog: Native time selection with Now button
  - DateTimePickerDialog: Combined date and time selection in one dialog
• Theme Presets: Material, Fluent, and Cupertino design system presets
  - DialogThemePresets.MaterialLight/MaterialDark
  - DialogThemePresets.FluentLight/FluentDark
  - DialogThemePresets.CupertinoLight/CupertinoDark
  - Factory methods: DialogTheme.Material(), DialogTheme.Fluent(), DialogTheme.Cupertino()
• Custom Animations: Configurable dialog animations
  - DialogAnimationType enum (Fade, Scale, SlideUp, SlideDown, etc.)
  - IDialogAnimation interface for custom animations
  - DialogAnimationFactory for creating animations
• MVVM Support: RelayCommand and DialogCommands helper classes
  - RelayCommand, RelayCommand<T>, AsyncRelayCommand
  - DialogCommands factory methods for common dialog patterns
• Input Validation Framework: Fluent validation API
  - InputValidationService with Required, MinLength, MaxLength, Email, Phone validators
  - ValidationOptions for configuring validation behavior
  - Custom validators via CustomValidator or IInputValidator
• Accessibility Improvements: AccessibilityHelper class
  - AutomationId naming convention: MADialog_{DialogType}_{ControlType}_{Name}
  - SemanticProperties configuration helpers
  - WCAG contrast ratio checking
• Performance Telemetry: Opt-in dialog usage analytics
  - IDialogTelemetry interface
  - DialogTelemetryEvent for open/close tracking
  - TelemetryConfiguration for enabling/configuring telemetry
• Additional Localizations: Chinese (zh), Japanese (ja), Portuguese (pt), Italian (it)
  - Full translations for all dialog strings
  - Date/Time picker strings
  - Validation error messages

IMPROVEMENTS:
• 8 supported languages (EN, ES, FR, DE, ZH, JA, PT, IT)
• Theme-aware animations with platform fallbacks
• Consistent API patterns across all new dialogs

BREAKING CHANGES:
• None - fully backward compatible with v1.4.1

Version 1.4.1 - ActionItem Callbacks & Toast Horizontal Positioning:

NEW FEATURES:
• ActionItem Action Callbacks: Define Action or AsyncAction directly on ActionItem for automatic invocation on selection
  - new ActionItem("Name", () => DoSomething(), "description") for sync callbacks
  - new ActionItem("Name", async () => await DoSomethingAsync(), "description") for async callbacks
  - Eliminates need for switch statements on returned values
• ActionListDialog.ShowWithActionsAsync(): New method returning bool for action-based dialogs
• Toast Horizontal Positioning: Position toasts in corners or edges of screen
  - ToastHorizontalPosition enum (Left, Center, Right)
  - Combine with ToastPosition (Top, Bottom) for 6 position options
  - Corner toasts appear instantly without slide animation

IMPROVEMENTS:
• ActionItem.InvokeActionAsync() method for manual action invocation
• ActionItem.HasAction property to check if callback is defined
• AsyncAction takes precedence over Action when both are set

BREAKING CHANGES:
• None - fully backward compatible with v1.4.0

Version 1.4.0 - Toast & Snackbar Notifications:

NEW FEATURES:
• Toast Notifications: Lightweight, non-interactive notifications for quick status updates
  - Configurable position (Top/Bottom) and duration (Short 2s, Long 3.5s, or custom)
  - Optional icons using existing DialogType
  - Configurable stacking behavior (Stack, Replace, Queue)
• Snackbar Notifications: Actionable notifications with optional buttons
  - Action button with callback support (UNDO, RETRY, VIEW, etc.)
  - Short (4s), Long (7s), or Indefinite duration options
  - Swipe-to-dismiss support
  - Returns SnackbarResult (ActionClicked, Dismissed, TimedOut)
• New Localization Strings: Added DISMISS, UNDO, RETRY translations for EN, ES, FR, DE

IMPROVEMENTS:
• Non-blocking notifications allow continued user interaction
• Multiple notifications can stack vertically with configurable max count
• Consistent theming with existing dialog components

BREAKING CHANGES:
• None - fully backward compatible with v1.3.0

Version 1.3.0 - Hierarchical Menus & Critical Bug Fix:

NEW FEATURES:
• Hierarchical Action List Support: ActionItem.SubItems property enables multi-level menu navigation
• Seamless Navigation: Navigate through menu hierarchies within a single dialog instance
• Automatic Back Navigation: Cancel/Back button automatically handles submenu navigation
• Unlimited Nesting: Support for any depth of menu hierarchies

BUG FIXES:
• CRITICAL: Fixed "duplicate key" exception when showing dialogs immediately after ActionListDialog dismissal
• Fixed race condition where PopAsync wasn't awaited before returning result
• Ensures ActionListDialog is fully removed from Mopups stack before caller continues

IMPROVEMENTS:
• Better async handling in dialog dismissal for smoother transitions
• Improved reliability when chaining multiple dialogs

BREAKING CHANGES:
• None - fully backward compatible with v1.2.0

Version 1.2.0 - Title & Description Customization:

NEW FEATURES:
• Title MaxLines Support: Configure maximum number of lines for dialog titles via DialogTheme.TitleMaxLines (default: 2)
• Title LineBreakMode: Configure how titles are truncated/wrapped via DialogTheme.TitleLineBreakMode (default: TailTruncation)
• HTML Description Support: Enable HTML formatting in descriptions via DialogTheme.DescriptionTextType (default: Text)
• Theme-level Control: Apply formatting globally through theme settings for consistent UX

KNOWN LIMITATIONS:
• HeadTruncation and MiddleTruncation may not render correctly on Windows due to MAUI framework limitations
• For cross-platform compatibility, use TailTruncation (default), WordWrap, CharacterWrap, or NoWrap

BREAKING CHANGES:
• None - fully backward compatible with v1.1.0

Version 1.1.0 - Enhanced Action List Dialog & Improved UX:

NEW FEATURES:
• Multi-line Description Support: ActionListDialog now supports 2, 3, or more lines for item descriptions
• Configurable Line Break Modes: Choose between TailTruncation, WordWrap, CharacterWrap, HeadTruncation, and MiddleTruncation
• Dynamic Description Updates: Change DescriptionMaxLines and DescriptionLineBreakMode properties after dialog creation
• Intelligent Scrolling: Automatically shows scrollbar when content exceeds dialog height based on line settings

IMPROVEMENTS:
• Fixed Dialog Height: ActionListDialog now maintains consistent height with scrollable content area
• Instant Dismissal: All dialogs now respect DialogTheme.EnableAnimation setting for instant or animated dismissal
• Better UX: Controls are disabled immediately on interaction to prevent double-taps and accidental multiple selections
• Optimized Layout: Switched to Grid-based layout for better text wrapping and performance

BUG FIXES:
• Fixed cancel button being cut off at bottom of ActionListDialog
• Fixed scrollbar not appearing for multi-line descriptions
• Fixed height calculation to account for variable description line counts

BREAKING CHANGES:
• None - fully backward compatible with v1.0.0

Previous release v1.0.0:
• 7 dialog types: Alert, Confirm, Prompt, Editor, Loading, ActionList, ColorPicker
• Built-in dark/light theme support with automatic detection
• Internationalization support (English, Spanish, French, German)
• Custom icon support with platform-specific optimizations
• Cross-platform support (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS)
title: MarketAlly Dialogs for .NET MAUI
